# dist/

Auto-generated artifacts — **do not hand-edit**. Each file is
regenerated by the matching `build.rs` on every `cargo build`: the
shell completion scripts derived from each CLI's `cli.rs`, and the
`*.defaults.yaml` config references mirrored from each CLI crate's
`defaults_reference.yaml`.

If these change after a CLI edit, commit them alongside it. See
[`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) — "Auto-maintained artifacts".

**Exception:** [`grafana/`](grafana/) (reference Grafana dashboards +
Prometheus alert rules) is **hand-maintained**, not generated by
`build.rs`. Edit those files directly; see
[`grafana/README.md`](grafana/README.md).
